name: Tail Release Log
description: On the site that publishes releases, reads every new entry of the public Sigstore logs nodes trust, looking for entries signed with our release statement key. Each one must be a release this site published (the release ledger); one that is not is a release nodes would install that nobody here published, and Reconcile Incidents raises it as critical. Reads for at most four minutes a run and carries on next run; a log not read up to date for a day is its own incident.
